input.title: Ontario OM Compliance Review — North Capital Series A
input.document_excerpt: The issuer offers Class A units to accredited investors only. Past performance has consistently exceeded benchmarks. Subscription proceeds will be applied to general working capital. Risk factors are listed in Schedule B.
input.reviewer_instruction: Check investor disclosure, use of proceeds, past performance claims, and risk factor adequacy against NI 45-106 and OSC Rule 45-501.

findings.title: Use of proceeds is not itemised
Statutory rights of action — disclosure not located
Risk-factor schedule referenced but not inspected

views.counsel: Disclosure is too promotional without adequate limitation; the rule requires a balanced presentation.
views.risk: High risk because the language directly invites investor reliance and elevates suitability exposure.
views.evidence: Cannot stand without verifiable benchmark identification, period, and methodology citation — the source layer is empty.

material_disagreement.final_action: Rewrite the performance claim with a benchmarked, period-bounded, net-of-fees calculation. Attach a verified authority before resubmission.

engine_receipt.workflow: 3 reviewer passes (parallel) → editor synthesis → optional Round 2 reflection

disclosure: Demo seed. The Ontario OM excerpt and findings are illustrative — not a real customer engagement.
